messages:
alex: FYI p95 jumped ~2x on euw2 A10 after merge r5110, started ~09:12 UTC. No obvious infra alerts, looks runtime-specific. Canary traffic shows same.
lee: saw the CI perf run too, p99 tail also up. CI run id `ci/perf-euw2-a10/1915`.
perf-bot: alert: runtime-serving-p95-surge euw2-a10 (threshold breach) — runbook linked.
marta: which part of r5110? I only see kernel selector changes + batching wait tweak.
alex: r5110 changed kernel selection scoring (favor faster fp16-int8 path for mid-length sequences) and increased batch_wait_ms from 3 -> 8 for better throughput.
devon: quick profile dump from canary node (snippet):
```
# host: euw2-a10-node-17
p95: 220ms (baseline 110ms)
kernel_select_time: +12ms
kvcache_evictions/sec: 0.62 (baseline 0.18)
nic_tx_bytes spike correlated with evictions
stack: kernel_picker::score() hot, batch_scheduler::wait() increased
```
lee: kvcache eviction rate jump is suspicious. If batches wait longer we might be pushing working set differently -> more evicts.
prash: also possible kernel selector is choosing kernels that increase memory pressure (different tiling) on A10 NIC paths. Seen similar on small-prefetch patterns.
ops-bot: telemetry: euw2-a10-nic-queue-length 78 -> 140 around spike window, host CPU steady.
devon: I ran a quick A/B on a canary: disable `kernel_score_override` => p95 back to ~115ms. Disable `batch_wait` change alone => p95 ~170ms (partially better).
marta: that points to selector change being primary culprit. Can we revert selector tweak only?
alex: agree. I'll prepare a revert for just the score override. We should hold rollout for r5110 across EUW2 until canary verifies.
lee: filing PR r5123 to revert kernel score override, tagging @oncall-eng-runtime and adding test that repros high-concurrency small-prefetch pattern.
prash: note: I also checked us-west h100 canaries — small bump but not as bad. Likely A10-specific interaction with tiling/kern choice.
devon: plan: (1) revert selector change in euw2-canary, (2) add microbench across A10/L4/H100 to measure kernel selection cost+mem pressure, (3) add CI perf test with kvcache churn pattern.
marta: and add a telemetry check for kvcache eviction rate so rollouts fail fast on regressions.
perf-bot: scheduled CI benchmark `ci/perf-euw2-a10/run-191501` for validation after revert.
alex: rolled back selector on canary (r5123 deployed to euw2-canary). Monitoring now.
lee: canary p95 trending down to baseline after ~5 minutes.
ops-bot: nic-queue-length back to 60, kvcache_evictions/sec back to 0.19.
marta: great — leave canary for 30m then promote. Also include PR notes describing why batching + selector interact with KV cache.
devon: I'll follow up with a profiler trace and a small repro harness.
prash: reminder: check scheduler hysteresis when reverting — we don't want to reintroduce throughput regressions for large-batch workloads.
alex: noted. thanks everyone. Links: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/serving-runtime-euw2-a10
lee: :thumbsup:
